summary: Phase 1 (Trust & Payments Week-1) backend testing complete. All 32 pytest cases pass (7 sanity + 25 e2e). Covered: mocked email verify (send/confirm/reuse/already-verified), mocked phone verify (send/confirm/wrong-code/short-phone), seller apply gating (blocks without verification, tax_id masked as ****XXXX, seller_status=pending), duplicate-pending block, GET /api/seller/application, mocked Stripe Connect onboard (acct_mock_* + active, idempotent already_active), stripe status, admin queue list & status_filter, non-admin 403, admin approve flips user.seller_status=approved and creates notification, admin reject with admin_notes, /api/admin/stats now includes pending_seller_apps, listing gate returns 403 for non-approved users and admin bypasses. Existing flows (login, listings list, categories, cart, favorites, sync/status) still work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1964 lines — should be split into routers/modules (auth, listings, seller, verify, stripe, admin) per >700 lines rule.
In-file `import secrets, random` at line 1484 should be moved to the top-of-file imports for consistency.
SellerApplication.tax_id stores only ****XXXX in DB which is correct for mock, but a comment/TODO should note real impl must tokenize via a PCI-safe provider (currently only a comment on line 375).
verify_email_confirm/verify_phone_confirm handle both string and naive datetime expires_at — good defensive coding, but ideally normalize on write so the runtime branches disappear.
Notification created on seller-approval links to /verify — should probably deep-link to /seller/apply or /profile once approved (currently points to /verify per line 1717).
admin_review_seller_app accepts a raw `dict` for updates — should use a Pydantic model (SellerAppReview) so `admin_notes` type and unknown fields are validated.

seed_data_creation: Test file registers ephemeral users prefixed e2e_phase1_*, e2e_block_*, e2e_reject_* per run. Also creates 'Approved Listing TEST' and 'Admin Direct TEST' listings — safe to leave or cleanup manually if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 1 endpoints all pass. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_trust_payments.py works with the enforced pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope) by keeping the full verification->apply->admin-review journey in a single class (TestPhase1E2E) so class-scoped fixtures stay on one worker. Frontend flows (/verify, /seller/apply, /admin/seller-applications) still need UI testing in a later iteration.
